tasks.label: Portfolio: preview automatica
tasks.command: cd "${workspaceFolder}/WebApp" && EXISTING_PID="$(lsof -tiTCP:3000 -sTCP:LISTEN | head -n 1)"; if [ -n "$EXISTING_PID" ]; then EXISTING_CMD="$(ps -p "$EXISTING_PID" -o command=)"; if echo "$EXISTING_CMD" | grep -Eiq "node|npm|vite"; then kill "$EXISTING_PID"; sleep 1; fi; fi; npm run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --strictPort
